comment: The one definition of the tool categories. Manifests refer to a category by id; tools/validate.py rejects any other value. 'icon' is a glyph of the NEXUS symbolic icon set (desktop/ui/icons).

categories.name: Information Gathering
categories.description: Discovering hosts, services, names and public information about a target that is in scope.

categories.name: Vulnerability Analysis
categories.description: Checking systems and configurations for known weaknesses.

categories.name: Web Application
categories.description: Testing web applications, their servers and their transport security.

categories.name: Password Auditing
categories.description: Assessing password strength and recovering lost credentials.

categories.name: Wireless and Radio
categories.description: Auditing Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and other radio links.

categories.name: Exploitation
categories.description: Demonstrating that a weakness can be used, within an agreed scope.

categories.name: Sniffing and Spoofing
categories.description: Capturing, analysing and crafting network traffic.

categories.name: Post-Exploitation and Pivoting
categories.description: Working from a foothold: directory services, remote access and tunnelling.

categories.name: Forensics
categories.description: Acquiring and examining evidence from disks, memory, files and logs.

categories.name: Reverse Engineering
categories.description: Understanding binaries, firmware and mobile applications.

categories.name: Hardware and Embedded
categories.description: Talking to chips, buses and debug interfaces.

categories.name: Reporting and Documentation
categories.description: Keeping notes and evidence and writing the report.

categories.name: Defensive and Monitoring
categories.description: Detecting intrusions, hardening systems and watching what they do.

categories.name: Development
categories.description: Compilers, debuggers, analysers and languages for building and reviewing software.

categories.name: Virtualization and Labs
categories.description: Virtual machines and containers for isolated practice environments.

categories.name: Network and System Utilities
categories.description: General-purpose tools that the other categories build on.
